name: Bonapartenykus
sum: The largest known alvarezsaurid, from the Late Cretaceous Allen Formation of Río Negro, Argentina, found with eggs.
holotype: MPCA 1290, a partial skeleton including a dorsal vertebra, both scapulocoracoids, left femur and tibia, Allen Formation, Río Negro, Argentina.
material: Only the holotype, found close to two eggs and eggshell clusters of the oogenus Arriagadoolithus.
biology: The association with eggs suggests the eggs belonged to this animal; it was redescribed with 3D models in 2025–2026 (Meso et al.).
author: Agnolin et al. 2012
